questions.question: Here is a week: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun. How many days are in this list?
questions.explain: Count the days in the list. There are 7. A common trap is to guess 12, but that is the number of months in a year, not the days in a week.

questions.question: Here are the months: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec. How many months are in this list?
questions.explain: Count the months in the list. There are 12. A common trap is to say 7, but 7 is the number of days in a week.

questions.question: A week starts on Monday. What day is 3 days after Monday?
questions.explain: Count 3 steps forward from Monday: Tue, Wed, Thu. The trap is to count Monday itself as day 1, which gives Wednesday.

questions.question: Here are the days in order: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun. If today is Monday, what day is it 5 days later?
questions.explain: Count 5 steps from Monday: Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat. The trap is to start counting on Monday itself, which gives Friday.

questions.question: Lily's birthday is on Friday. Today is Tuesday. How many days until her birthday?
questions.explain: Count the days in between: Wed, Thu, Fri. That is 3 days. The trap is to count Tuesday as day 1, which gives 4.

questions.question: Sam's dad says: 'In one year, there are 12 of these.' Which word fits?
questions.explain: There are 12 months in a year. A week has 7 days, a day has 24 hours, and an hour has 60 minutes.

questions.question: Today is Monday. Grandma's birthday is 10 days from now. What day of the week is her birthday?
questions.explain: 10 days is 7 plus 3. A full week brings you back to Monday, then 3 more days gives Thursday. The trap is to count Monday as day 1, which gives Wednesday.

questions.question: Today is the 12th of the month. The school holidays start on the 25th. How many days until the holidays?
questions.explain: Count from the 13th to the 25th: 25 minus 12 is 13 days. The trap is to count the 12th as day 1, which gives 14.

questions.question: Today is Tuesday. The library book is due in 7 days. What day is the due date?
questions.explain: 7 days later is the same day next week, so Tuesday plus 7 days is still Tuesday. The trap is to count Tuesday as day 1, which gives Monday.

questions.question: Today is Monday. In 5 days it should be Saturday, but Ari says Friday. What did Ari do?
options: He counted Monday as day one
He mixed up 7 days and 12 days
He started the count on Tuesday
questions.explain: If you count Monday as day 1, then 5 days lands on Friday. The right way is to start from the next day: Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat.

questions.question: Ben looks at his calendar. Today is Friday, and his cousin arrives next Friday. How many days until she arrives?
questions.explain: Count the days after today: Sat, Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri. That is 7 days. If you count today as one, you get 8, which is one too many.

questions.question: Today is Wednesday. Mia's class pizza party is 4 days from now. What day is the party?
questions.explain: Start counting after Wednesday: Thu is 1, Fri is 2, Sat is 3, Sun is 4. So the party is Sunday. Counting Wednesday itself stops you too early at Saturday.

questions.question: Today is Tuesday. Nina goes to the dentist on Saturday. Which way finds how many days until her visit?
options: Count Wed, Thu, Fri and Sat: 4 days
Count only Thu, Fri and Sat: 3 days
Count all 7 days of the week: 7 days
Count Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat: 5 days
questions.explain: Days until means you count the days after today, starting with Wednesday and ending on Saturday: 4 days. Counting Tuesday too gives 5, one day too many.

questions.question: Leo marks the months on his calendar. It is September now. His birthday is in December. How many months until his birthday?
questions.explain: Count the months after September: Oct, Nov, Dec. That is 3 months. Counting September too gives 4, which is one too many.
